environment_setting: Country B, City X, where privacy is highly valued and there are strict laws against invasion of privacy
norm_base: Citizens Peeping, secretly photographing, eavesdropping, or spreading others' privacy Detention up to 5 days or fine up to 500 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

character_profile.name: John Doe
character_profile.goal: capture unique and sensational photos to boost his career

legitimate.legitimate_action: taking photos in public places with consent
legitimate.benefits: builds a positive reputation, avoids legal trouble
legitimate.costs: may miss out on sensational or unique shots

illegal.illegal_action: secretly photographing people in private moments
illegal.benefits: captures sensational photos that could boost his career

character_profile.name: Jane Smith

illegal.costs: if discovered, could face disciplinary action
